topics.title: Caching Strategy
topics.content: Caching reduces repeated read latency but introduces invalidation complexity. Cache invalidation should balance freshness and performance. A read-through cache keeps the database authoritative while serving hot reads locally. Stale reads are the main correctness risk once a cache is introduced.

topics.title: Connection Pooling
topics.content: Connection pooling bounds concurrent database connections and reuses warm ones. A statement timeout bounds waiting but does not release locks unless cancellation is honoured. Pool size should be derived from the database connection limit divided by the number of instances.

topics.title: Distributed Systems Reliability
topics.content: Idempotency means repeated requests should not create additional side effects. Retry safety requires request deduplication and clear idempotency keys. A bounded retry budget keeps provider rate limits from turning one user action into a fan-out. Deduplication storage should be keyed on the caller-supplied idempotency key and a retention window. Tradeoffs appear when the retention window is shorter than the retry horizon.
